verdict.rationale: LanceDB is Apache-2.0 licensed and its storage layer is disk-first, running on local NVMe/EBS/EFS or any S3-compatible object store, meaning data lives in open Lance-format files under user control rather than in a proprietary managed silo. However, there is no explicit documentation of an 'export' workflow (e.g., converting to Parquet/CSV, bulk data-export CLI, or migration guide) proving users can straightforwardly leave with all data intact. Missing for 10: explicit export/migration documentation, third-party corroboration of successful data extraction/portability.
